zh: 网页版盘点。SuXin Barcode Scan · 电脑或手机浏览器
en: SuXin Barcode Scan in the browser

zh: 和手机 app 同一个账号、同一份盘点
en: Same account and the same counts as the phone app

zh: 用扫码枪或镜头扫，扫几次就是几个
en: Scan with a scanner or the camera; each scan adds one

zh: 称重的或很多的：先输入数量再扫
en: Weighed or many: type the quantity, then scan
Tap a number to change it

zh: 完成后不能再改；仓库系统马上看到差异
en: Finished counts are locked; the warehouse sees the differences at once
